measured_costs_not_declared_ones.python_file_op: 0.06 ms elevation; write is a single syscall
measured_costs_not_declared_ones.cli_exec: 97 ms steady state, 206 ms first call (declared <50 ms) -- 2x WORSE than declared
measured_costs_not_declared_ones.why: bare subprocess.run is 2.0 ms; the confinement boundary is ~95 ms of that
measured_costs_not_declared_ones.position: that is the price of safety, and it is the correct price. But the layer table must not keep claiming <50 ms.

what_this_now_supports: the owner's thesis, in the shape that is actually true: ONE demonstration becomes a PERMANENT, PARAMETERISED, INSTANT skill in FOUR independent environment shapes, each with an exact verifier, at zero trained parameters and zero model calls
